definition: Whether ChexSystems is reportedly consulted when opening this deposit account. EWS use, hard/soft credit pulls, adverse reporting, and accepting bad history are separate. Unknown includes absent, qualified, conflicting, and mixed evidence.

first_party_research.quoted_excerpt: When you apply for a bank account, the bank may use a reporting system like ChexSystems to look at your previous banking history.
first_party_research.disposition: Not used to assign yes: general educational wording says may and does not precisely commit BMO Smart Advantage to a screening policy. Targeted first-party searches for TruStone, PSECU, KeyBank and Capital One did not yield precise usable policy; no result is not evidence of no screening.

retrieval_limitations: Repeated web extracts returned inconsistent/truncated article bodies and omitted the screening fields. Live rendered browser pages were captured and are the authoritative quotations for assignments.
No selected yes/no is claimed as issuer-confirmed. Secondary DoC fields can be stale even when campaign updates are current.
Do not alter general last_verified or offer requirements on the basis of screening-only research.

caveats: Explicit yes in the current September 2026 campaign article. Secondary reported screening, not a bank guarantee. Applied only to the six Smart Advantage checking tiers, not the separate Savings Builder product.
